\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 180-183 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R188-first-pass-words-from-chapters-180-183}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for July and August.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to be shy, to quarrel, to celebrate; to win round, to mix; to introduce, to join
  \item to spend, to pay off, to measure, to weigh, to check
  \item to get tired, to rest, to lie down, to stand up, to wait
  \item to pay a visit, to marry, to be alive, to die, to increase
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To be shy? (\textbf{\ur{شرمانا}}, \emph{sharmānā}.) To quarrel? (\textbf{\ur{جھگڑنا}}, \emph{jhagaṛnā}.) To celebrate; to win round? (\textbf{\ur{منانا}}, \emph{manānā}.) To mix; to introduce? (\textbf{\ur{ملانا}}, \emph{milānā}.) To join? (\textbf{\ur{جوڑنا}}, \emph{joṛnā}.) To spend? (\textbf{\ur{خرچ} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{kharch karnā}.) To pay off? (\textbf{\ur{چکانا}}, \emph{chukānā}.) To measure? (\textbf{\ur{ناپنا}}, \emph{nāpnā}.) To weigh? (\textbf{\ur{تولنا}}, \emph{tolnā}.) To check? (\textbf{\ur{جانچنا}}, \emph{jāṅchnā}.) To get tired? (\textbf{\ur{تھکنا}}, \emph{thaknā}.) To rest? (\textbf{\ur{آرام} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{ārām karnā}.) To lie down? (\textbf{\ur{لیٹنا}}, \emph{leṭnā}.) To stand up? (\textbf{\ur{کھڑا} \ur{ہونا}}, \emph{khaṛā honā}.) To wait? (\textbf{\ur{انتظار} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{intizār karnā}.) To pay a visit? (\textbf{\ur{ملاقات} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{mulāqāt karnā}.) To marry? (\textbf{\ur{شادی} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{shādī karnā}.) To be alive? (\textbf{\ur{جینا}}, \emph{jīnā}.) To die? (\textbf{\ur{مرنا}}, \emph{marnā}.) To increase? (\textbf{\ur{بڑھانا}}, \emph{baṛhānā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 184-188 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R188-second-pass-words-from-chapters-184-188}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to fall ill and to swell.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to fall ill, to swell, to shiver, to get wet, to travel
  \item a pill; a bullet, a prescription, an injection, a wound, an injury
  \item a heel, a fist, a palm, the liver, a lung
  \item a swelling, a dose; food, a diet, exercise, the body
  \item April, May, June, July, August
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To fall ill? (\textbf{\ur{بیمار} \ur{پڑنا}}, \emph{bīmār paṛnā}.) To swell? (\textbf{\ur{سوجنا}}, \emph{sūjnā}.) To shiver? (\textbf{\ur{کانپنا}}, \emph{kāṅpnā}.) To get wet? (\textbf{\ur{بھیگنا}}, \emph{bhīgnā}.) To travel? (\textbf{\ur{سفر} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{safar karnā}.) A pill; a bullet? (\textbf{\ur{گولی}}, \emph{golī}.) A prescription? (\textbf{\ur{نسخہ}}, \emph{nuskhā}.) An injection? (\textbf{\ur{انجکشن}}, \emph{injekshan}.) A wound? (\textbf{\ur{زخم}}, \emph{zakhm}.) An injury? (\textbf{\ur{چوٹ}}, \emph{choṭ}.) A heel? (\textbf{\ur{ایڑی}}, \emph{eṛī}.) A fist? (\textbf{\ur{مٹھی}}, \emph{muṭṭhī}.) A palm? (\textbf{\ur{ہتھیلی}}, \emph{hathelī}.) The liver? (\textbf{\ur{جگر}}, \emph{jigar}.) A lung? (\textbf{\ur{پھیپھڑا}}, \emph{phephṛā}.) A swelling? (\textbf{\ur{سوجن}}, \emph{sūjan}.) A dose; food? (\textbf{\ur{خوراک}}, \emph{khurāk}.) A diet? (\textbf{\ur{پرہیز}}, \emph{parhez}.) Exercise? (\textbf{\ur{ورزش}}, \emph{varzish}.) The body? (\textbf{\ur{جسم}}, \emph{jism}.) April? (\textbf{\ur{اپریل}}, \emph{aprail}.) May? (\textbf{\ur{مئی}}, \emph{maī}.) June? (\textbf{\ur{جون}}, \emph{jūn}.) July? (\textbf{\ur{جولائی}}, \emph{julāī}.) August? (\textbf{\ur{اگست}}, \emph{agast}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
